stories.headline: From wartime tanker to Great Lakes freighter
stories.history: Built in 1942 as the tanker Chiwawa, she served during World War II before reconstruction for the Great Lakes ore trade.
stories.imageAlt: Lee A. Tregurtha transiting the Soo Locks in 2021.
stories.photoCredit: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Detroit District · public domain · 2021

stories.headline: A thousand-footer built for the lakes
stories.history: Launched in 1976, James R. Barker became the first thousand-foot Great Lakes ship built with its wheelhouse aft.
stories.imageAlt: James R. Barker crossing the Straits of Mackinac in 2014.
